reviews.text: Such a great experience   First time visitor. They were able to accommodate last minute changes. Such a great group of people here.  Thank you!!

Disappointed with the care and massive upselling. Nearly a year ago, I brought my dog here for an ear infection. Instead of focusing on treating the actual issue, the clinic heavily pushed unnecessary add-ons and expensive extras. Ultimately, their treatment failed entirely and the infection never cleared up. I had to go to a second vet to finally get my dog relief, bringing my total costs well over $1,000 between the two clinics. I am still incredibly disappointed by this experience and cannot recommend a place that prioritizes profit over a pet's health.
Kind, knowledgeable medical staff and competent, conversational desk staff.
Thank you!
Lovely veterinary office! Kind staff and clean facilities.
Thank you!

I don't write reviews unless I'm genuinely impressed, and Dr. Trisha was absolutely amazing! I've been to a lot of animal clinics where the appointment feels rushed and the vet is just in and out. But, Dr. Trisha actually took the time to really listen and she was super thorough. My dog was nervous but still took treats from her, which is a big deal because he usually won't take treats from strangers - so that was a definite yes from him. The reception team was also awesome - friendly and helpful. I would absolutely recommend Paws on Fraser.

It’s never fun having a sick animal, but I trust the staff here to treat my chihuahua with the most love and care possible. He used to cry shake and pant at the vet in fear, here he loves every single person in the clinic. They are exceptionally patient and genuinely interested how your pet is doing throughout their healing journeys, while also being really awesome people to chat with too. Importantly too, they are honest, upfront and fair about pricing, and I’ve never once felt like they’ve pushed or suggested unnecessary services or treatments. I would, and have recommended them to friends and family and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone else looking for a great vet!!

Paws on Fraser is wonderful! The staff are always willing to take the time to make sure your pet is comfortable. We see Dr. Jenna and would highly recommend her to anyone seeking straightforward and compassionate care for their animals!
Much appreciated!
Dr. Trisha Kong is amazing! Her calm and caring attitude really helped with our 4 cats, she went above and beyond to ensure that they were as comfortable as possible!

My husky gets very scared when he needs anesthesia. I was shocked by how well he behaved during / after his surgery. It is not normal for him. He was treated very well, and it made a huge difference in how he was acting. I highly recommend Paws on Fraser if you need to schedule a surgery for your dog.
Wonderful experience

Dr Jenna and team are super sweet and helpful. Not only do they seem to care about your animals well being they also seen to care about your wallet. They don't try to up sell you like alot of vets do and they are transparent with all costs and make sure you're comfortable with everything before moving forward. My fur babies have had surgeries, regular checkups and medication prescriptions here. Happy we found Paws on Fraser as our new veterinarians!
Clean, caring and kind staff
Thank you so much!

My Go to Vet. I’ve never felt so secure as a pet parent as I do when I go here. The front staff, the techs, the assists - everyone in this clinic cares about your pet like a family member as well as making sure you are okay too with knowledge and pricing and options. Even if I moved away I would find myself coming back to this clinic for my boy 💓🐕
Much appreciated!

Visiting here for the first time on a recommendation from a friend in the Rescue community that I work with. Dr. Yuen is so impressive. I highly recommend this clinic. Within my first five minutes of my appointment I’ve already learned two things that previous vets have not told me is possible in regards to testing with my cat.
It’s been really frustrating to find a vet clinic that hasn’t let me down in very serious ways and cost my cat her health, and myself thousands of needless dollars. I’m so happy to finally have found a place where I can trust that my cat is in the best care. This appointment today did not feel rushed in anyway and Dr. Yue even allowed me to use her stethoscope to hear my cat’s heartbeat.
If you’re frustrated with not finding the proper care that you need for your animal, this is definitely the place to come. The front desk staff are also incredible, efficient, helpful and kind. Excellent prices for exam, blood/urine work. Subcutaneous fluid administration can be found for 1/2 price elsewhere though, just saying that as  cats with kidney disease can require this daily and if one can’t do it themselves, the cost may be prohibitive.

Vets and staff are wonderful, very caring and compassionate. They take the time to listen and answer eevry questions you have. They will do what's right and provide the care that is needed by your companion
Thank you!

We’ve had such a great experience with Paws on Fraser. The staff are incredibly friendly, helpful and welcoming, and the veterinarians are clearly very knowledgeable and take the time to explain everything in a way that’s easy to understand. We have a feisty older cat who can be quite a handful, but they always handle him with so much care and compassion. It’s clear they genuinely care about their patients, and that makes a huge difference. We feel confident and comfortable bringing our pet here every time!

My husband and I love paws on fraser.
We really feel like they take the time to explain and answer all of our questions. Frodo is usually scared to go to the vet but I know he is in good and patient hands <3

Clean, straightforward, and efficient clinic! I trust my kitty cat in their hands on her health and staff is always nice☺️Usually really calm and never had to wait for appointments, so it is as less stressful as a vet trip can be for my anxious kitty which is really appreciated. They also were super helpful with over the phone questions about care as I never had a long haired cat before. Really convenient location is a big bonus for me and is located next to a big pet supply shop. My cat soba below :)
Great independent vet clinic, not part of a major corporation trying to make you spend more than you need to. Caring, lovely staff and Doctors. Highly recommend.
Paws on Fraser is a fantastic practice. My dog recently had a procedure and I couldn't be happier with her treatment, the service provided and the price
This is a long overdue 5 ⭐️ review for Dr. Jenna and the rest of the lovely team at Paws on Fraser. They are very thorough and caring and supportive. I highly recommend them!
Thank you so much!
Nothing but good things to say about my experience with Paws on Fraser. Excellent facility.

The staff at Paws on Fraser are so very kind and patient. Jenna and Loretta provided the loving care we were hoping to get for our big fat cat who unfortunately acquired fleas.
Their facility is very modern, clean and well designed (with the bonus of being next door to a lovely neighbourhood coffee shop). Streetside parking is easy to come by both along Fraser or along 19th Avenue.

(edit: There's also underground parking accessed from the alley!)

After a very gentle yet thorough examination, the instructions Jenna gave us to administer Milo's medication were very easy to follow. She left us feeling very confident that Milo will easily recover after completing his 3 months of flea medication which included 3 oral tablets and a topical ointment (an additional ointment was opted for in order to directly treat his little itchy spots too).

We were more than happy with the service and care we received for Milo and we look forward to our appointment next month to follow up on his booster shots.
